findings.summary: Initial summary loading redundantly refetches data already loaded for the active initial mode.
findings.consequence: SSR and first load for non-standalone modes can spend extra API work on the active tab: authors can trigger a second author search, and works/parts/epub/pdf can trigger a count for a total that the active page response already carries before initialLibrarySummaryValue merges it.
findings.evidence: fetchInitialData always starts fetchLibrarySummary for ordinary, non-download routes at line 464 while line 460 already fetches initialState page data. initialLibrarySummaryValue later fills authors/works/parts/epub/pdf summary slots from initialPageData, so the active slot does not require the duplicated summary request.
findings.recommendation: Pass the active LibraryPageState into the summary-building path or let fetchLibrarySummary accept an omitted active mode/count so the initial request only fetches missing tab counts.
